features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F Main Unit; power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
Pinhole lens (fixed iris, fixed focus) for extremely discreet surveillance, e.g. ATMs, retail, vending machines
Aluminum casing; mounts behind thin metal, plastic or glass panels with included AXIS F8206 Pinhole Mounting Bracket
Detachable 8 m cable to the main unit (cable weight 128 g)
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (ds_f1004_pinhole_t10079460_en_2010.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded.
